items.name: Granular.Build
items.description: Put your AI agents to work in a visual workspace. Big ideas shouldn't require a dozen AI tools or a programming background. Granular brings your models, agents, files, and project context into one visual workspace. Give a boss agent your goal, let it coordinate specialists in parallel, and watch apps, designs, or videos take shape with live previews. Bring your own AI, use built-in terminals and plugins when you need them, and keep each project's memory and files in one place. Go from first plan to published result.

raw_data.tagline: Put your AI agents to work in a visual workspace

items.name: Clam AI
items.description: Your inbox, safely shared with AI agents. Your inbox is a master key: password resets, bank alerts and health reports all run through it. Clam lets AI agents work in your email without holding that key. You write the rules in plain English, like "Read travel email. Draft replies. Never send." Each agent sees and does only what its rules allow, and you see everything it tries. We start with Gmail. We are building the permission layer for MCP: one that understands what the data means and the context of every request.

raw_data.tagline: Your inbox, safely shared with AI agents

items.name: Viktor Code
items.description: Coding agents know your repo. Viktor knows your company.. Coding agents know your repository. Viktor knows your company: your customers, your metrics and the decisions behind the work. So you give him a business outcome, not a ticket. He splits it into the technical and the non-technical work. He opens pull requests on your GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket repos and brings them back for your review. His projects belong to the whole team, in Slack, Teams or Discord. Anyone can code now. Free to start, with up to $100 in credits.

raw_data.tagline: Coding agents know your repo. Viktor knows your company.

items.name: frwrd.to
items.description: Your link in bio, sorted by your AI in one message. Send your AI assistant your current link in bio or your website. It keeps what matters, matches your brand and publishes the page in every language you need. Campaigns end on their own, and you can edit everything by hand too.

raw_data.tagline: Your link in bio, sorted by your AI in one message

items.name: Claude Ship
items.description: Ship code as fast as you can write it. Ship code as fast as you can write it: Claude Ship reviews, fixes, and approves pull requests, taking each one from opened to ready to merge. Code Review posts verified findings on each PR. PR Steward (beta) fixes failing CI, conflicts, and review feedback, but never merges. Claude Approvals (beta) approves routine changes under your team's policy file and asks a human about the rest. Run /ship in Claude Code to push, open the PR, and hand it off. For Claude Team and Enterprise on GitHub.

raw_data.tagline: Ship code as fast as you can write it

items.name: tday.com
items.description: AI-recorded Screen Studio style editable demos. Most features ship without a demo video. A good one takes hours to script, record, retake, voice and edit. Ask for a demo in one line from Claude Code, Cursor or Codex. Your coding agent records your real app on your machine, localhost included, and tday adds the voice, cursor, zooms, captions and your brand. Edit any narration line, then use it in your launch, docs or changelog. Web, desktop, terminal, iPhone and Android apps. Your code never leaves your machine. Free for 5 saved demos.

raw_data.tagline: AI-recorded Screen Studio style editable demos

items.name: Agenda Hero Magic Labs
items.description: Any schedule. Any layout. Any style.. We’re replacing the static PDF calendar with a new kind of artifact built for date and time. From the team offsite to the soccer season, make a beautifully designed plan. It’s powered by live data, so when the plan changes, the design and subscribed calendars stay up to date. Try it today in Agenda Hero Magic Labs.

raw_data.tagline: Any schedule. Any layout. Any style.

items.name: Valley
items.description: Outbound system to find people most likely to buy from you. Valley finds the people most likely to buy from you, from live buying signals, plain-English search or your own lists. It checks each one against your ICP, researches them, and writes a personal message across LinkedIn and email. You approve every message, replies land in one inbox, and it runs from Claude or ChatGPT via MCP. Teams see 15-45% reply rates vs about 2% for cold outreach. Bolt.new booked 25 enterprise demos in 45 days. Book a demo to see it on your own leads.

raw_data.tagline: Outbound system to find people most likely to buy from you

items.name: doola MCP
items.description: Start and run your US company from your AI assistant. The doola MCP lets founders start and run a US company from ChatGPT, Claude, and any tool that supports MCP. Form an LLC or C-Corp in any of the 50 states in one chat, from account setup to submission. Already a doola customer? Connect your account and ask your AI Co-Founder for your EIN letter, formation documents and deadlines. doola Bookkeeping customers can also pull financial reports, and connected Shopify or ad accounts add sales and ad spend trends. Add mcp.doola.com as a connector.

raw_data.tagline: Start and run your US company from your AI assistant

items.name: Pinned
items.description: Ask the city where to go tonight with your friends. Ask Pinned where to go tonight, the way you'd text a friend who knows the city. Pinned AI reads every spot nearby and brings back the three that fit your whole crew, with a reason for each. Then drop a pin with the plan, and your friends say "I'm down" in one tap. Try a real Ask at pinned.social, no download needed. Free on iPhone and Android, made in New York for people who'd rather be out than online.

raw_data.tagline: Ask the city where to go tonight with your friends

items.name: Fleetify
items.description: Open-source command center for your AI coding agents. Fleetify is a free, open-source desktop app for running AI coding agents side by side. Start sessions with Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and seven more agents, or with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenRouter and local Ollama models. Watch them all from the Fleet hub: status, spend, tokens and live activity. Give each task its own git worktree, preview your dev server, open PRs, and install a plugin once for every agent that supports it. macOS, Windows, Linux.

raw_data.tagline: Open-source command center for your AI coding agents

items.name: Astor
items.description: AI Thesis Investing. Astor is the personal investing agent for thesis-driven investors. Tell Astor what you believe in, e.g. “the grid is AI’s bottleneck.” Astor builds the portfolio and explains every pick. It monitors your thesis every market day, and when the story changes, it tells you how to adjust. You approve every trade. Free to start.

raw_data.tagline: AI Thesis Investing

items.name: HeroUI Pro 1.0
items.description: Premium UI components, templates, and AI tooling for React. HeroUI Pro is the premium tier of HeroUI (formerly NextUI). 118+ production-ready Pro components with 900+ examples: 65+ for React, built on Tailwind CSS v4 and React Aria (data grid, charts, kanban, agenda, rich text editor, maps, and a full AI chat kit), and 53+ for React Native on iOS and Android. Plus full-page templates, and MCP servers and Agent Skills so Cursor and Claude build with your design system. One perpetual license, unlimited projects.

raw_data.tagline: Premium UI components, templates, and AI tooling for React

items.name: Finseo
items.description: Company brain + outreach to get your brand mentioned by AI. Finseo now acts on your AI visibility, not just measures it. Company Brain puts your website, docs, Drive, Search Console, GA4 and AI tracking into one searchable map: ask anything, get answers with sources. Outreach finds the pages AI answers cite where your brand is missing, finds the editors and drafts pitches in your brand voice, with every claim checked against your Brain before you approve.

raw_data.tagline: Company brain + outreach to get your brand mentioned by AI

items.name: Almma's PII Guard
items.description: Catch personal data before it reaches your AI chat. A free, open-source browser extension that flags names, emails, numbers, dates and addresses in the message box of claude.ai and chat.almma.ai, and replaces them with placeholders like [NAME_1] before you send. Pasted text is held for review. Typed text is underlined in red and Send is blocked until you decide. Everything runs locally: the code contains no network calls, and the README shows how to check. MIT licensed.

raw_data.tagline: Catch personal data before it reaches your AI chat

items.name: Cullman
items.description: Faster voice agent evals, from simulation to production. Cullman is an evals platform for building and shipping reliable voice agents. Evaluate every prompt, model, and voice change with text simulations, voice simulations, and real human testers, scored against your custom rubrics. Compare versions, catch regressions, and validate improvements before you deploy. Run simulations in minutes and human tests in days. Then keep evaluating in production with live-call scoring, call traces, and split tests. Test, deploy, and improve your agent in one place.

raw_data.tagline: Faster voice agent evals, from simulation to production

items.name: mindyOne
items.description: Your Instagram DMs. Now with an AI receptionist.. mindyOne is an AI receptionist for your Instagram DMs. When someone asks for a time, it answers from your prices and hours, offers only slots that are really free, and books the appointment right in the chat: a name, a read-back and a yes. It also reschedules and cancels, says it's an AI, and steps back when you reply. Built for businesses whose DMs end in a booking: trainers, salons, photographers, studios, consultants. Build yours from a description and talk to it before you sign up.

raw_data.tagline: Your Instagram DMs. Now with an AI receptionist.

items.name: Scribase MCP Server
items.description: A Postgres backend your coding agent sets up by MCP. Scribase MCP Server gives Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Windsurf, Zed and VS Code 97 tools over a hosted Postgres backend: database, auth, storage, realtime and functions. The agent creates the project, runs SQL and migrations, and writes the keys into your app. Reads run at once; destructive changes wait for your confirm, and schema changes can be gated on a passing row-level-security test. Remote server, nothing to run. Free for 14 days, no card, then from $5 a project.

raw_data.tagline: A Postgres backend your coding agent sets up by MCP

items.name: Tendor
items.description: Write it or ask it, from anywhere on Windows. Write down a thought or ask AI without leaving what you're doing. Press a hotkey and Tendor opens over any app on Windows 11. Type to save a task or note, start with ? to ask AI, or ?! to send your screen too. The AI reads your tasks and notes from any day, asking before it opens an older one. Save instructions as Skills and run them with /name, or type /newskill and the AI writes one. Use your own key from 8 providers. Plain Markdown, no account, free to start.

raw_data.tagline: Write it or ask it, from anywhere on Windows

items.name: K-Stra
items.description: Geomarketing for Australia, with an AI that does the maths. Where should we open next? K-Stra answers that for retailers, franchise networks and property teams in Australia. Give it an address and it draws the real drive-time catchment, then shows who lives there, what they earn and spend, which competitors are nearby, what property costs and an estimate of road and foot traffic. An AI assistant sets up the analysis from a plain-English question and shows the price in credits before anything runs. Free to explore, no subscription required.

raw_data.tagline: Geomarketing for Australia, with an AI that does the maths

It also shows AI agent approvals and usage limits for Claude, Codex and more. Native Swift, no account, 2-day free trial.

raw_data.tagline: A live Dynamic Island for your MacBook notch

items.description: Shake your cursor, ask AI about anything on screen. DeskMagic is a Windows app that puts AI right next to whatever you're looking at. items.description: Learns how you write, then writes exactly as you would. Prates learns from what you write across any app: who you write to, your projects, your views and your wording. It turns speech into finished text, drafts replies and completes what you type. What it learns stays as short notes on your Mac that you can read or delete. Voice and text go only to the models you choose and have available, locally or in the cloud. macOS 14+. 7-day free trial, then $9.99 per month.

raw_data.tagline: Learns how you write, then writes exactly as you would

items.name: Flourish
items.description: The AI coach helping you complete tasks & achieve your goals. Most apps help you do more. Flourish helps you do what matters. It checks in to keep you moving, learns your priorities over time and adjusts with you when life changes, even if that means making today’s plan smaller. Less mental load. More room for life.
